title: Project skills
selectHint: Select or create a skill to edit its project-local files.

description.tauri: Desktop mode reads and writes project-local skills in .cursor/skills/. Only top-level text files are editable for safety.
description.browser: Browser mode cannot access .cursor/skills/ directly, so skills created here are stored in localStorage as a preview workspace. Use Tauri mode to edit project files.

detail.safeFiles: Editable files are limited to top-level .md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml, and .toml files.
